targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, "value_percent" AS Prozent
FROM "percent_values"
WHERE measurement_id = 'Envoy_EnvoyM1_M1_BatteryLevel'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT time, "value_percent" AS Prozent
FROM "percent_values"
WHERE measurement_id = 'Envoy_EnvoyM3_M3_BatteryLevel'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value_watt AS "PV"
FROM "power_values"
WHERE sensor_type = 'Envoy'
  AND measurement = 'PowerFromPV'
  AND location = 'M1'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  CASE WHEN value_watt >= 0 THEN  value_watt ELSE 0 END AS "BattEntl",
  CASE WHEN value_watt  < 0 THEN -value_watt ELSE 0 END AS "BattLaden"
FROM "power_values"
WHERE sensor_type = 'Envoy'
  AND measurement = 'PowerFromBattery'
  AND location = 'M1'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  CASE WHEN value_watt >= 0 THEN  value_watt ELSE 0 END AS "Netzbezug",
  CASE WHEN value_watt  < 0 THEN -value_watt ELSE 0 END AS "Netzeinspeisung"
FROM "power_values"
WHERE sensor_type = 'Envoy'
  AND measurement = 'PowerFromGrid'
  AND location = 'M1'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value_watt AS "Haus"
FROM "power_values"
WHERE sensor_type = 'Envoy'
  AND measurement = 'PowerToHouse'
  AND location = 'M1'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT device, AVG(value_watt) AS "watt"
FROM "power_values"
WHERE sensor_type = 'Shelly'
  AND measurement = 'Power'
  AND location = 'M1'
  AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '2 minutes'
GROUP BY device

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(value_cumulated_kwh) - MIN(value_cumulated_kwh), 0) AS "PV_kwh"
FROM "energy_values"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND sensor_type = 'Envoy'
  AND measurement = 'EnergyFromPV'
  AND location = 'M1'

SELECT
  COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN avg_w >= 0 THEN  avg_w ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "BattEntl",
  COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN avg_w  < 0 THEN -avg_w ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "BattLaden"
FROM (
  SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time,
           TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS t,
         AVG(value_watt) AS avg_w
  FROM "power_values"
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND sensor_type = 'Envoy'
    AND measurement = 'PowerFromBattery'
    AND location = 'M1'
  GROUP BY t
)

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(value_cumulated_kwh) - MIN(value_cumulated_kwh), 0) AS "Netzbezug_kwh"
FROM "energy_values"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND sensor_type = 'SMLSensor'
  AND measurement = 'GridConsumption'
  AND device = 'Smartmeter_M1'

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(value_cumulated_kwh) - MIN(value_cumulated_kwh), 0) AS "Netzeinspeis_kwh"

WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
